coverage: The complete retained HTML envelope is byte-bound. All three populated source-native carriers, all 23 document headings, the Contents table, prefatory toggle, main body, inline elements, links, and source comments within the carriers are in scope. independence: The oracle uses separate DOM traversal and mapping code from the producer. Both currently share lxml HTML parsing and the exact same retained source bytes; the complete-document heading census and ticket-local tests independently corroborate carrier paths and comment locations. Do not treat parser agreement as independent evidence.
